title: A US court slashed a $74.5m tax break on 310 Tennessee acres to $500,000, upholding a 40% penalty
summary_full: The United States Tax Court delivered a decisive blow to Lontrac Enterprises, LLC, reducing their claimed tax deduction for a conservation easement from $74.5 million to $500,000. The ruling highlighted the partnership's failure to provide credible evidence, resulting in the imposition of a 40 percent penalty from the IRS for a gross valuation misstatement. This case illustrates the ongoing struggles faced by taxpayers involved in syndicated conservation easement transactions.
